KazeX Morph browser MP4 encoder

encoder.wasm contains minih264, minimp4 and C runtime support. The two
upstream codec/muxer headers are included verbatim under
tools/encoder/upstream in the KazeX Morph source repository.

minih264 (H.264 encoder)
  https://github.com/lieff/minih264/tree/207dee34b6996cc51570ca3b92f2f98c76176749
  CC0 1.0 Universal. See licenses/CC0-1.0.txt.

minimp4 (MP4 muxer)
  https://github.com/lieff/minimp4/tree/741a704744895416258daef4a789965c528130c2
  Based on https://github.com/aspt/mp4
  CC0 1.0 Universal. See licenses/CC0-1.0.txt.

Build toolchain and runtime
  Zig 0.14.1 / zig cc, wasm32-wasi, MVP instruction set.
  https://github.com/ziglang/zig/tree/0.14.1
  https://github.com/ziglang/zig/tree/0.14.1/lib/libc/wasi
  Zig contributions: licenses/Zig-MIT.txt.
  wasi-libc: licenses/wasi-libc-notice.txt, licenses/wasi-libc-MIT.txt,
  licenses/wasi-libc-Apache-2.0.txt, licenses/wasi-libc-LLVM-exception.txt.
  Third-party runtime notices: licenses/musl-COPYRIGHT.txt,
  licenses/cloudlibc-BSD.txt, licenses/emmalloc.txt, licenses/CC0-1.0.txt.
  emmalloc copyright 2018 The Emscripten Authors.

Rebuilding
  Install Zig 0.14.1 and Python 3. From the repository root, run
      python3 tools/encoder/build.py
  Set ZIG to the Zig executable path if it is not on PATH.
  The script verifies the source checksums, sets the H.264 colour metadata
  and minimum level, and gives the movie and video track matching 90 kHz
  timescales. The encoder produces one video sample for each supplied frame.
  All inputs, compiled sources and exported video stay on the device at runtime.

  Shipped encoder.wasm SHA-256
  93580e68970aa28fba9b32321a4fd0eb148a2374acc6cd9f12225b527a1778d2
